blind_read: The seated monkey answers a banana phone, reconsiders and eats it.
inspection: Reviewed native decoded brown GIFs while blinded, then enlarged the exposures and checked the current intro and waiting timing against the brief.

evidence.observation: The empty hand reaches down, picks up the banana and brings it to the ear. The 660 ms ear hold gives the phone gag time to register.
The eyes turn toward the banana in front of the face. It is peeled before the mouth closes over it. The half-eaten fruit remains in hand during the chewing hold.
